title.rest: I unblock, structure and speed up your projects

hero.lead: When a project stalls, I give a clear diagnosis and a sound technical framework, and delivery gets going again. I use AI to move faster, and I answer for every line.

values.title: One promise: getting your project moving again.

items.title: I unblock
items.text: A diagnosis in a few days, clear technical decisions, blockers removed. You know where you stand and what to do first.

items.title: I structure
items.text: Architecture, tests, CI/CD, code reviews: rigour without bureaucracy, so the team delivers with confidence.

items.title: I speed things up
items.text: I optimise how the team develops, AI included, with code that is reviewed, tested, and that I answer for line by line.

items.title: Technical audit
items.text: A factual review and a prioritised action plan.

items.title: Tech Lead / Lead Dev engagement
items.text: A technical lead who frames, codes and helps the team grow.

items.title: Project rescue
items.text: Stabilise, get back on track, hand over cleanly.
